def policy(obs, P):
    cos1 = obs[0]
    sin1 = obs[1]
    cos2 = obs[2]
    sin2 = obs[3]
    v1 = obs[4]
    v2 = obs[5]
    cos12 = cos1*cos2 - sin1*sin2
    sin12 = sin1*cos2 + cos1*sin2
    PE = 2.0 - cos1 - cos12
    if PE > P['pe_thr']:
        u = -P['kp1']*sin1 - P['kp2']*sin12 - P['kd1']*v1 - P['kd2']*v2
        if u > P['th_b']:
            return 2
        elif u < -P['th_b']:
            return 0
        else:
            return 1
    KE = P['k1']*v1*v1 + P['k2']*v2*v2
    E = P['pe']*PE + KE
    err = P['Ed'] - E
    if np.abs(v1) < P['v_min'] and np.abs(v2) < P['v_min']:
        return 2
    u_e = P['ge']*err*v2
    u_p = -P['gv1']*v1*cos2
    u = u_e + u_p
    if u > P['th']:
        return 2
    elif u < -P['th']:
        return 0
    else:
        if sin1*v1 < 0:
            return 2 if v1 > 0 else 0
        return 1
